03 / ABOUT

A little about me

I’m studying Software Engineering at Shenkar, and I like turning ideas into things people can actually use.

My work moves between developer tools, interactive websites, visual experiments, and games. I’m especially interested in how a system is built — and how it feels to use.

Outside the code, I enjoy gaming, tinkering with hardware, and experimenting with design. Those interests often find their way back into my projects.
